summary: P1+P2 backend regression: 16/17 tests PASSED. Validated new /api/country-config/rates-flat endpoint (DR and CO: labels, codes, rates, currency correctly switched). /api/dgii-reports/summary is multi-country adaptable (DR returns 4 employer contributions SFS_EMP/AFP_EMP/SRL/INFOTEP; CO returns all 6: SALUD_EMP/PENSION_EMP/ARL/CCF/ICBF/SENA with 8.5/12/0.522/4/3/2 rates). All 6 DR-specific endpoints (tss/autodeterminacion, tss/novedades, ir3, ir17, payroll tss-preview, payroll tss-report) correctly return 400 when company country != DO. DR regression OK for 5/6 endpoints. 1 FAILURE: /api/dgii-reports/tss/autodeterminacion throws 500 AttributeError when any active employee has document_number=None (pre-existing bug, not introduced by P1/P2 refactor, but affects DR customers and should be fixed). Company country restored to DO at end.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error. Root cause: dgii_reports.py line 170 `cedula = emp.get('document_number', '').replace('-', '')` fails with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'replace' when an active employee has document_number=None (dict has the key but value is None, so default '' is not used). Pre-existing bug – NOT introduced by P1/P2 refactor (the offending code was not modified); but DR customers with any null document_number will hit 500. Fix: `(emp.get('document_number') or '').replace('-', '')`.

action_items: Fix dgii_reports.py line 170 (and any similar `.get(key, '').replace(...)` patterns e.g. first_name/last_name) using `(emp.get('document_number') or '').replace('-', '')` to handle NULL values gracefully. Same defensive pattern should be applied on line 170 (document_number), line 180 (first_name), line 181 (last_name) to be safe.
critical_code_review_comments: country_config.py get_company_rates_flat(): clean implementation; correctly maps first 2 employee deductions to sfs/afp slots and first 4 employer contributions to sfs/afp/srl/infotep slots. Missing slots default to 0.0 – safe for countries with fewer bands.

dgii_reports.py _require_dr() guard is idiomatic FastAPI with clear Spanish error messages referencing /api/dgii-reports/summary as the cross-country alternative. Applied consistently to autodeterminacion, novedades, ir3, ir17.

dgii_reports.py /summary correctly preserves legacy DR tss.total_tss and slots (afp_employee, afp_employer, sfs_employee, sfs_employer, risk_labor, infotep) by mapping country-specific rates into those slots. Also adds new employee_deductions_detail and employer_contributions_detail for multi-country richness. Good backward-compat.
payroll_exports.py _require_dr_company() helper duplicates _require_dr() from dgii_reports.py with slightly different wording. Consider extracting into a shared helper in utils/ to DRY. Minor.
Pre-existing defensive-coding issue in dgii_reports.py lines 170, 180, 181: `emp.get('field', '')` fallback doesn't handle None values. Should use `(emp.get('field') or '')`.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests only switch country between DO<->CO and call GET endpoints. Country state restored to DO via module autouse teardown fixture. Verified via /api/country-config/company.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Company test_refactor@fortexa.com is restored to DO at end of run. One failure: /dgii-reports/tss/autodeterminacion returns 500 when a DR employee has document_number=None. Fix is 1-line in /app/backend/routes/dgii_reports.py line 170 (and similarly for first_name/last_name defensive). After fix, re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_country_config_rates_flat_and_dgii.py -v`. All P1 rates-flat + P2 multi-country /summary + all 6 DR-specific guards work correctly.

rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) Login as test_refactor@fortexa.com 2) Ensure country=DO 3) GET /api/dgii-reports/tss/autodeterminacion?period=2026-03 -> 500
rca of the issue.root_cause: dgii_reports.py:170 uses `emp.get('document_number', '').replace('-','')`. When an active employee document in MongoDB has {document_number: null} (key present, value None), dict.get returns None (not the default ''), and calling .replace on None raises AttributeError.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Change to `cedula = (emp.get('document_number') or '').replace('-', '')`. Apply the same defensive pattern to first_name and last_name lines to prevent future 500s.
rca of the issue.regression_risk: Low. Tests in test_country_config_rates_flat_and_dgii.py::TestDrRegression will verify the fix.
